name: RedHen CRM
description: Native Drupal CRM framework: Contact, Organization and Connection entities modelling constituents and their relationships.
project_description: RedHen CRM is a native, Drupal-entity-based CRM framework brought to you by ThinkShout, aimed initially at membership organizations, associations and nonprofits but built for flexibility. Rather than integrating with a CRM hosted elsewhere, RedHen models constituents as Drupal content entities: a Contact entity (people, optionally linked to a Drupal user account), an Organization entity, and a Connection entity that models fieldable relationships between them. Because these are ordinary content entities they are fieldable, revisionable, Views-integrable and governed by Drupal entity access. Like Drupal Commerce, the core module ships shared APIs and the functionality lives in submodules (redhen_contact, redhen_org, redhen_connection, redhen_dedupe); it requires configuration before it is a working CRM. RedHen is also positioned as an integration point to enterprise CRMs such as Salesforce (ThinkShout also maintains the Salesforce module). Note: this 3.0.x line is an alpha and ships only the contact, org, connection and dedupe submodules — the historical membership, note, engagement and groups submodules described in older documentation are not present in this release.
